public_rationale: The forecast is conditional on OpenAI collapsing. That antecedent was not established by the evaluation date, while dated disclosures describe ongoing commercial activity. Existing business relationships do not themselves establish the losses predicted after collapse.
limitations: The claim is broad and supplies no minimum scale of damage.
Ongoing collaboration does not establish long-term financial viability.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI's collapse will have unavoidable economic consequences.

statement.excerpt: As I discussed in the OpenAI Bubble, its collapse will have now-unavoidable economic consequences.

our_interpretation: In context, economic consequences means adverse effects outside OpenAI, such as creditor losses, investor write-downs or counterparty revenue losses.
The claim does not specify a minimum loss, an economy-wide recession, or the failure of any particular counterparty.
Unavoidable means that a collapse would produce adverse economic effects despite mitigation; it does not mean that every exposed party must suffer.
criteria.support_condition: After a documented collapse, reliable records establish attributable creditor losses, investment write-downs or counterparty revenue losses.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented collapse and completed resolution of its exposures establish that counterparties and investors avoided the predicted adverse economic effects.
